title: da workflow hook sentinel
description: Schema for `.agents/active/hook-sentinels/<skill>-<run-id>.json`, written by `da workflow hook-sentinel write` at skill entry. Each enforced skill (iteration-close, isp, loop-worker, orchestrator-session-start, delegation-lifecycle) declares plan/task/agent context and expected artifacts so a downstream Stop/SubagentStop gate can validate them before allowing the agent to stop. Companion skills (orchestrator-session-start, delegation-lifecycle) additionally declare an `operation` discriminator scoped to their gate. `clear --run-id` on the success path archives the record under `.agents/history/<plan-id>/hook-sentinels/<YYYY-MM-DD>/`; no record is silently deleted in v1.

schema_version.description: Schema version 1 — initial sentinel contract (plus T1 companion extension).

skill.description: Enforced skill whose contract the gate will validate at stop/subagent-stop. Companion skills (orchestrator-session-start, delegation-lifecycle) extend the upstream trio per the T1 contract.

run_id.description: Caller-supplied run identifier; combined with skill to key the sentinel filename. Restricted to filename-safe characters.

started_at.description: RFC3339 / RFC3339Nano timestamp recorded when the sentinel was written. `read --latest` selects the most recent value with filename as the deterministic tie-breaker.

plan_id.description: Canonical plan id this sentinel binds to. Used by `clear` to compute the per-plan archive path under `.agents/history/<plan-id>/hook-sentinels/<YYYY-MM-DD>/`.

task_id.description: Task id within the plan whose work is governed by this sentinel.

agent_type.description: Caller's agent role. The loop-worker gate self-filters by reading this field (D6); non-loop-worker subagents exit 0 early when this is `main`.

lifecycle_point.description: Lifecycle moment at which the sentinel was emitted. v1 only ships `skill_entry`; later versions may introduce additional points without breaking the v1 enum because new values would arrive with a schema_version bump.

expected_artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths the terminal gate MUST find on disk before allowing stop. Empty arrays are allowed for skills whose artifact list is computed dynamically by the gate.

context.description: Skill-specific context. Omit fields that do not apply to the calling skill rather than assigning invented meaning.

git_head_at_start.description: Git HEAD commit id captured by the CLI at sentinel-write time. Callers MUST NOT supply an untrusted replacement — `write` discards any caller-supplied value and re-resolves HEAD itself.

write_scope.description: Allowed repo-relative paths or globs. The loop-worker gate diffs subagent edits against this list.

eligible_snapshot_loaded.description: ISP gate signal: true when the orchestrator loaded the eligible-task snapshot from orchestrator-session-start; false means the ISP gate may need to verify a re-run of `workflow orient`.

max_batch.description: ISP gate signal: declared maximum bundles to materialize this turn. 0 means unset/not applicable.

trace_path_hint.description: Optional caller-supplied hint to a readable transcript/trace path. Hook stdin remains authoritative when it provides a platform trace path (D7).

operation.description: Companion-gate operation discriminator (T1). Only valid when skill is orchestrator-session-start or delegation-lifecycle; the per-skill conditional below restricts the allowed enum to the operations supported by each companion gate.

delegation_path.description: Companion (handoff operations): repo-relative path to the delegation YAML the orchestrator either expects to materialize (fanout_handoff) or routes the worker to (existing_bundle_handoff).

bundle_path.description: Companion (handoff operations): repo-relative path to the delegation-bundle YAML the worker will consume.

required_sidecar_path.description: Companion (fanout_handoff only): optional repo-relative sidecar artifact path required by the gate before the fanout is allowed to publish.

evidence_confidence.description: Companion (fanout_handoff only): optional evidence-confidence label captured at handoff time.

decision.description: Companion (parent_closeout only): the closeout decision the parent will assert against.

expected_archive_artifacts.description: Companion (parent_closeout only): repo-relative archive-bound artifacts the closeout gate expects to find under `.agents/history/<plan-id>/...`.

expected_cleanup_paths.description: Companion (parent_closeout only): repo-relative active paths the closeout gate expects to clear (delegation YAML, bundle YAML, merge-back drafts, etc.).
